headline: Approved first reading of a Biddeford Middle School seventh-grade overnight field trip to the Ecology School.
summary: Members approved the September 9 minutes and a first reading of a seventh-grade overnight trip to the Ecology School. Reports covered the STEM/Press M Lab program, bus driver staffing, and student activities. The meeting then moved into executive session to discuss labor contract proposals.
decisions: Approved the September 9, 2026 meeting minutes by unanimous vote, as part of the consent agenda.
Approved the first reading of the BMS seventh-grade overnight field trip to the Ecology School by unanimous vote.
